package parsing

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "github.com/codegirl-007/jevlint/internal/config"
 tree_sitter "github.com/tree-sitter/go-tree-sitter"
)

func TestMuseCapture(t *testing.T) {
 cfgPath:=os.Getenv("MUSE_CAPTURE_CONFIG");if cfgPath=="" {cfgPath="../../jevlint.json"}
 cfg, err := config.Load(cfgPath); if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 ex, err := NewExtractor(cfg.Languages); if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 var records []any
 sourceRoot:=os.Getenv("MUSE_CAPTURE_ROOT");if sourceRoot=="" {sourceRoot="../../examples/rules"}
 err = filepath.WalkDir(sourceRoot, func(p string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
  if err != nil {return err}; if d.IsDir() || !ex.Supports(p) {return nil}
  spec := ex.byExtension[strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(p))]
  switch spec.name {case "typescript", "tsx", "javascript", "python", "go", "rust", "java": default: return nil}
  source, err := os.ReadFile(p); if err != nil {return err}
  expected, err := ex.Extract(p, source); if err != nil {return err}
  tree, err := parseSource(spec,p,source); if err != nil {return err}; defer tree.Close()
  var nodes []map[string]any; ids := map[uintptr]int{}
  var walk func(*tree_sitter.Node,int,int)
  walk = func(n *tree_sitter.Node,parent,previous int) {
   index := len(nodes); ids[n.Id()] = index
   nodes = append(nodes,map[string]any{"kind":n.Kind(),"startByte":n.StartByte(),"endByte":n.EndByte(),"parent":parent,"previous":previous})
   prior := -1
   for i:=uint(0);i<n.NamedChildCount();i++ {child:=n.NamedChild(i); if child!=nil {next:=len(nodes);walk(child,index,prior);prior=next}}
  }
  walk(tree.RootNode(),-1,-1)
  queries := map[string]any{}
  for name, query := range map[string]*tree_sitter.Query{"function":spec.functionQuery,"type":spec.typeQuery,"context":spec.typeContextQuery,"call":spec.callQuery} {
   matches := []map[string]int{}
   if query != nil {cursor:=tree_sitter.NewQueryCursor(); iter:=cursor.Matches(query,tree.RootNode(),source)
    for {match:=iter.Next();if match==nil {break}; captures:=map[string]int{};for _,c:=range match.Captures {captures[query.CaptureNames()[c.Index]]=ids[c.Node.Id()]};matches=append(matches,captures)};cursor.Close()}
   queries[name]=matches
  }
  pointers := []*CodeUnit{};for i:=range expected {pointers=append(pointers,&expected[i])};ResolveCallees(pointers)
  details := []any{};for _,unit:=range expected {details=append(details,map[string]any{"unit":unit,"regions":unit.Regions,"calls":unit.CallRefs,"callees":ExpandCallees(unit.Resolved)})}
  records=append(records,map[string]any{"path":filepath.ToSlash(strings.TrimPrefix(p,"../../")),"language":spec.name,"source":string(source),"raw":map[string]any{"nodes":nodes,"queries":queries,"regionKinds":spec.regionKinds,"hasError":false},"expected":details})
  return nil
 }); if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 bytes,err:=json.Marshal(records);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("MUSE_CAPTURE_OUTPUT"),bytes,0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 t.Logf("captured %d real upstream files",len(records))
}
